fomod.Name: Vulpine Race - Human Nate Patch
fomod.Author: VulpineNateHuman
fomod.Description: Keeps the player character human while the rest of Vulpine Race is left alone. Overrides one record - the Player record - and points it back at vanilla HumanRace. The pre-war spouse NPC keeps her Vulpine race, so playing as Nate gives you a human Sole Survivor and a Vulpine Nora in the intro. ESL-flagged, so it does not use a regular plugin slot. Requires Vulpine Race V5.1. Start a new game after installing.
